name: Universal links
description: Opens app screens from https links on your domain (applinks), routed through the same typed DeepLink router as the custom URL scheme.

credentialsNeeded.description: Your domain (for example example.com) that serves apple-app-site-association
credentialsNeeded.whereToGet: A domain you control; host /.well-known/apple-app-site-association with an applinks entry for this app

cost.note: Apple Developer Program membership needed for device builds and distribution; simulator builds are free; needs a domain you control

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Keep `.onOpenURL { router.open($0) }` from deep-links and replace it with `.onOpenURL { router.open(UniversalLink.normalize($0) ?? $0) }` so https://<domain>/<screen>/<id> becomes the same DeepLink as the custom scheme. Share links with `UniversalLink.url(for: .item(screen: "orders", id: id))`, which falls back to the custom scheme until ASSOCIATED_DOMAIN is set.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify universal-links` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
